proof_availability.classification_scope: For the self-adjoint two-sector Hamiltonian H(g), an isolated finite native code at E, a domain-valid normalizable divided source (H_B-E)U1=-VP, and a domain-valid second dressing U2 give an exact residual of orders g^3 and g^4. Duhamel yields an O(|g|) code-isometry approximation to exp(-i tau K) at time hbar*tau/g^2, including reference-entangled inputs and finite-sequence telescoping. An exactly circular full-hyperfine rotation and magnetic parity supply a conditional finite-spin extension while retaining the deliberately open channel; its three-level nonaffine phase remains nonzero. The1143increment proves a separate spectral-window residual certificate even if the exact second divided vector is nonnormalizable: with no resonant point projection and the stated domain/graph bounds, shrinking windows yield o(1)code error on g^-2 times (regular density permits a conservative O(sqrt|g|)bound). Full physical quadratic curvature W must enter K: an axis-tilt source cancels its proposed many-body XX/ZZ interaction, while a positive three-body commutator loop is dominated by exact native conjugation using the same controls.
